author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw (CVE-2026-97229); attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: lemma_oracle
text: LiteLLM release built from an attacker's fork shipped with a genuine signature, live on PyPI for 1h44m (~49,000 downloads).

author: SockAnalystHQ
text: WordPress core CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1) actively exploited; CISA KEV Nov 3, deadline Nov 6. Core updates 4.7 to 7.1.3 stage installer in predictable public folder enabling no-login RCE. Fix: 7.1.4 or backport.

author: BleepinComputer
text: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks (CVE-2026-119977).

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Android November 2026 bulletin: critical Framework RCE with no user interaction (CVE-2026-58868), also critical zero-click RCEs CVE-2026-58876 and CVE-2026-58936. Google reports no in-the-wild exploitation.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Node-RED missing adminAuth actively exploited to drop bots and webshells (CVE-2026-58115). Critical, partly patched.

author: gurvrx
text: Ivanti Connect Secure root in the wild: 3 chained zero-days actively exploited by UTA0576: CVE-2026-104935 (unauth RCE), CVE-2026-111357 (priv-esc, CISA KEV), CVE-2026-118527 (file upload).

author: DarkControlAI
text: MoLing MCP server CVE-2026-62863 (CVSS 9.6, fixed in 0.5.0): in SSE mode a malicious web page could hijack its session and call its tools even when bound to localhost.

author: techyoutbe
text: More than 1,000 exposed GitLab instances unpatched against actively exploited CVE-2026-97229, a CVSS 10.0 RCE fixed in 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: WordPress Core (4.7-7.1.3) RCE is KEV-listed and actively exploited. Predictable staging paths during core upgrades let unauthenticated attackers slip in malicious code. CVE-2026-119977.

author: etugenio
text: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day operator's open directory holds the full in-band root exploit chain, 168 run logs, and a Russian AI-agent memory file, suggesting AI-agent-assisted exploitation.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Trojanized Claude Code extension versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 hit Cursor's marketplace on Oct 29, delivering SSH backdoors to developer workstations with no user interaction.

author: rst_cloud
text: An operator used the pentestcode AI agent against 25 mid-size and large European companies and reports breaching 10 of them.

author: morphisec
text: Northflank breach: attackers immediately weaponized stolen AI API keys; OpenAI, Anthropic and other provider credentials abused after the cloud development platform breach.

author: Basant_Pandey
text: Docker Sandboxes CVE-2026-103916 (via Endor Labs): sbx cp followed symlinks, so a prompt-injected agent could reach host creds and SSH keys. Upgrade to 0.51.0.

author: morphisec
text: Langflow critical RCE CVE-2026-105740 (CVSS 9.9) hit with 1,423 honeypot exploit attempts: any authenticated user can get RCE by registering an MCP server with stdio transport.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical SolarWinds Dameware command injection flaw, CVE-2026-28336, CVSS 9.9, could allow attackers to compromise remote systems.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical SonicWall GMS vulnerability exposes internal files without authentication, CVE-2026-109593.

author: fireball_triada
text: Langflow: IBM bulletin lists CVE-2026-93680 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-110186 (unauthenticated RCE through MCP tool enumeration).

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical zero-click Android RCE patched; CVE-2026-58868. Heap buffer overflow in Android Framework (FrameDecoder.cpp onOutputReceived) allows RCE without user interaction.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Google GTIG and Mandiant report LLMjacking incidents driving cloud AI charges above $100,000 per day and up to $1M, using exposed endpoints or stolen credentials and API keys.

author: morphisec
text: GhostAction supply chain: 500+ compromised GitHub accounts, 340+ repos; an active supply chain campaign specifically targeting MCP configs, AI platform tokens, and SSH keys.

author: OminouslyPie
text: Nikke CDN supply chain attack: gist documents how it works and remediation.

author: NamanyayG
text: Railway (breached Oct 21, users told to rotate keys) back in the news over secrets 12 days later, involving its AI agents.

author: kryll_ai
text: GitBook hit by AI-assisted breach. Users urged to rotate keys.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: LLMjacking is becoming a full-scale business: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant investigated incidents where criminals hijacked cloud AI access and resold it via underground subscriptions.

author: morphisec
text: Citrix confirms two NetScaler RCE zero-days exploited in attacks: CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 (CVSS 9.5) actively exploited, shellcode placed directly into memory.

author: cubillas888
text: OPSSHIELD says unauthorized access to its cPGuard update CDN let an attacker push a malicious script on Nov 2. Check 5.88.12-5.88.19, update to 5.88.25+, rotate DB and cloud keys.

author: num1_ch
text: GitHub reported a vulnerability linked to AI agents, urging users to change their login credentials.

author: Crypto3cats
text: Chainstack, a node and RPC provider many Web3 devs build on, disclosed a breach via a third-party component; attacker had 5 days inside. Customer names, emails and password hashes may be exposed.

author: morphisec
text: Carbonato botnet installs the Hermes AI agent on hijacked Docker hosts: worm-like botnet scanning for unauthenticated Docker APIs on port 2375, launches privileged containers.

author: swif_ai
text: Glow Labs: AI coding agents install archived MCP reference servers recalled from training data; their 4 high-severity flaws, incl. a prompt-injection RCE, won't be fixed. SCA misses them; check endpoint MCP configs.

author: morphisec
text: F5 BIG-IP APM zero-day CVE-2026-94127 actively exploited, 14,700+ instances exposed, added to CISA KEV: unauthenticated RCE in APM OAuth.

author: Michaelzsguo
text: Binance published RCA on the Oct 29 cyberattack ($6.34B stolen): started with a tampered developer tool and fake job interview, escalated through compromised laptops and internal AI tooling.

author: beincrypto
text: GitBook discloses targeted security breach driven by AI agents: attackers used AI agents to breach its infrastructure credentials, potentially exposing customer API tokens, Git Sync secrets and integration credentials. Rotate secrets.

author: keithrull
text: GitBook breached, rotate your tokens.

author: binarly_io
text: New research: Pre-auth RCE in Zyxel GS1900 exploited in the wild as a zero-day, linked to CVE-2026-7273 (KEV); the patch did not stop the exploit.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell), both CVSS v4.0 9.2, are actively exploited unauthenticated RCE flaws in PHP core. CISA added CVE-2026-109618 to KEV on 26 October 2026.

author: TonTraderCom
text: At least nine developer platforms targeted in October; attackers used stolen credentials to run $100K of AI services via OpenAI, Anthropic and Amazon Bedrock.
